name: Lead Capture to CRM
goal: Create or update CRM contacts and deals from a form, spreadsheet, or landing page submission.

setup_notes: Select the form, table, or sheet that contains new leads.
Load a recent test record before mapping fields.

workflow_steps.name: Normalize incoming fields
workflow_steps.instructions: Format email addresses in lowercase, trim extra spaces, and convert dates to the project timezone.

workflow_steps.name: Check for duplicates
workflow_steps.instructions: Search the CRM by duplicate_match_field before creating a new contact. Update the existing contact when a match is found.

workflow_steps.name: Apply qualification rules
workflow_steps.instructions: Continue only when the record meets the required qualification rules. Log disqualified records with the reason.

workflow_steps.name: Create or update CRM records
workflow_steps.instructions: Map every source field to the destination field map and create the contact, company, and deal records required by the project.

workflow_steps.name: Assign an owner
workflow_steps.instructions: Use the owner assignment method and fallback owner so no qualified lead is left unowned.

workflow_steps.name: Send internal notification
workflow_steps.instructions: Send a Slack, email, or task notification with the lead summary, assigned owner, source, score, and CRM link.

workflow_steps.name: Handle failures
workflow_steps.instructions: Send failed runs to the error alert channel with the source record link and the failing step name.

manual_tests.name: Happy path lead
manual_tests.input: Qualified test lead with all required fields.
manual_tests.expected_result: CRM contact and deal are created or updated, owner is assigned, and notification is sent.

manual_tests.name: Duplicate lead
manual_tests.input: Lead with an email address already in the CRM.
manual_tests.expected_result: Existing contact is updated instead of creating a duplicate.

manual_tests.name: Missing required field
manual_tests.expected_result: Workflow stops and sends an error alert.

handoff_instructions: Document the source app connection owner.
Save links to the automation, CRM list, and notification channel.
Review duplicate and error logs daily during the pilot stage.
